paragraphs: (A student of Rav Kahana, Rav Ashi’s teacher.) He took a large part in Rav Ashi’s academy, as Hyman says we always find: “Rav Hillel said to Rav Ashi: When I was at Rav Kahana’s,” as in [Shabbat 109a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.109a.4), [Beitzah 40a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.40a.11), [Yevamot 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.21b.16) and [Yevamot 26a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.26a.5), [Bava Batra 98a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.98a.11) and [Chullin 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.53a.4). He likewise said to Rav Ashi, “There was a case at Rav Kahana’s,” as in [Avodah Zarah 69a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.69a.1); and he said to him, “I myself saw Mar son of Ravna’s [list of] secondary [forbidden relations],” as in [Yevamot 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.21b.16).[^2]

notes.text: The final phrase concerns sheniyot, secondary forbidden relationships, not a mishnah list. Saved Davidson Yevamot 21b has Rav Hillel himself seeing Mar son of Ravna’s list. The first-person singular “when I was” and Hyman’s always assertion remain explicit.

Shabbat, Bava Batra, and Chullin give Hillel’s recollection of Rav Kahana’s school. The linked Yevamot instead gives his first-person report of seeing the list of secondary relationships. Hyman infers his broader role in Rav Ashi’s academy. Beitzah and Yevamot 26a give other exchanges with Rav Ashi. Avodah Zarah explicitly mentions a case at Rav Kahana’s school. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=314&lang=en).
